lesson_text: A parser that reads a git command's options must follow git's parse-options rules: a short-option cluster (`-fd` is `-f -d`, `-uo <v>` is `-u -o <v>`) and any unambiguous long-option prefix (`--del`, `--pu <v>`, `--rep <v>`) count as the option, or an option value shifts the positionals and the guard judges the wrong ref.
